{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis not described",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint in the study is the percent change in EASI score from baseline to week 16.",
      "page": 27,
      "section": "4.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The statistical methods section does not specify the analysis model for the primary endpoint (e.g., mixed model, ANCOVA) or how the estimand will be defined.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed description of the primary analysis method, including the statistical model, covariates, and handling of intercurrent events."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint in the study is the percent change in EASI score from baseline to week 16.",
      "page": 27,
      "section": "4.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint is incomplete: population (FAS is stated later), variable (EASI percent change), but intercurrent events (e.g., rescue medication, discontinuation) and summary measure (e.g., difference in means) are not defined.",
      "fix": "Specify the estimand attributes, including how intercurrent events will be handled and the summary measure for the treatment effect."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary efficacy endpoints lack analysis methods",
      "quote": "Proportion of patients achieving EASI-50, EASI-75, and EASI-90 (≥50%, ≥75%, and ≥90% improvement from baseline) at week 16",
      "page": 27,
      "section": "4.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not describe how binary secondary endpoints (e.g., EASI-50/75/90, IGA responder) will be analyzed (e.g., logistic regression, risk difference).",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for all secondary efficacy endpoints, including model and handling of missing data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for PK endpoint",
      "quote": "Concentrations of functional REGN3500 in serum by treatment regimen at each assessment timepoint from baseline to end of study (week 36)",
      "page": 27,
      "section": "4.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK endpoint is listed but no statistical analysis method is provided for it in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Describe the PK analysis methods, including descriptive statistics and any modeling (e.g., non-compartmental analysis)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for immunogenicity objective",
      "quote": "To assess the immunogenicity of REGN3500 in adult patients with moderate-to-severe AD",
      "page": 22,
      "section": "2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The immunogenicity objective has no corresponding endpoint or analysis described in the protocol.",
      "fix": "Add immunogenicity endpoints and their analysis methods."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for exploratory objectives",
      "quote": "The exploratory objectives of the study are to assess the effects of REGN3500 monotherapy on skin and blood biomarkers of inflammation, QOL, and patient-reported measures of pain and sleep quality in comparison with placebo.",
      "page": 23,
      "section": "2.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Exploratory endpoints are deferred to the SAP, but no analysis methods are provided in the protocol, leaving a gap.",
      "fix": "Provide at least a high-level analysis plan for exploratory endpoints or explicitly state they will be detailed in the SAP."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing sample size justification",
      "quote": "The following null and alternative hypotheses of the primary endpoint will be tested for each REGN3500 group and the placebo group:",
      "page": 65,
      "section": "10.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not include a sample size section or justification, which is a critical gap for a statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size section with assumptions (e.g., effect size, variability, dropout rate) and calculation details."
    },
    {
      "title": "Incomplete multiplicity control description",
      "quote": "To control the overall family-wise type I error rate of 5%, a hierarchical procedure from high to low dose will be performed for the primary endpoint and selected secondary efficacy endpoints (eg, EASI-75, IGA score of 0 or 1 and a reduction from baseline of ≥2 points responder at week 16) across the REGN3500 dose regimens vs placebo. The final hierarchy will be provided in the SAP that will be finalized prior to database lock.",
      "page": 65,
      "section": "10.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The hierarchy is not fully specified; it only mentions 'selected secondary efficacy endpoints' and defers to the SAP, which may lead to ambiguity.",
      "fix": "List all endpoints in the hierarchy and specify the order of testing in the protocol."
    }
  ]
}
